name: Nghe Tinh Soviet Museum
nameVi: Bảo tàng Xô viết Nghệ Tĩnh
kicker: The 1930–1931 rooms in the citadel yard
summary: Walk the 1930–1931 rooms in the citadel yard on Đào Tấn. More than 5,000 objects and photographs fill 10 rooms, nearly 2 km from the square. Since 23 May 2025 this is one museum with the provincial collection. The address is 7 and 10 Đào Tấn, and also 10 and 39. Hours are 07:30–12:00 and 13:30–17:00, every day. A fee is check on arrival.
getThere: 7 and 10 Đào Tấn, and also 10 and 39, nearly 2 km from the square.
heroCaption: The front of Bảo tàng Xô viết Nghệ Tĩnh
gettingThere: The merged museum is at 7 and 10 Đào Tấn, and also at 10 and 39 Đào Tấn. The ward is Thành Vinh, and also Cửa Nam. The Soviet rooms in this frame sit in the citadel yard, nearly 2 km from the square. Use both street numbers if you want the Soviet rooms and the provincial rooms. Minutes are check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Ho Chi Minh Square
legs.body: With the citadel, nearly 2 km. The minutes are check on arrival.

closed: No weekly closing day. The afternoon session starts at 13:30.
